items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: And yourself. And those titles are... [listing tracks]... And the second session... is Jelly Roll, again Ward Pinkett... and you

ctx.x: Let's see. First session is Jelly Roll Morton and his Red Hot Peppers from March 5, 1930 with Jelly Roll, Ward Pinkett and another on trumpets--do you remember who the other one was?
